class Shape {

  final int x;
  final int y;
  final String label;

  Shape(this.x, this.y, {required this.label});

  int area() {
    return this.x * this.y;
  }

}
class Square extends Shape {

  final int border;

  Square(super.x, super.y, this.border, {required super.label});

  int framed() {
    return area() + this.border;
  }

}
class Tall extends Square {

  Tall(super.x, super.border, {required super.label});

}
